mutations.name: the gpt-6 family default is dropped — the live 0-cache-read finding is left with no lever, and the measured write-every-round pattern can never be tested against the hint
the family regex matches every model — the hint lands on Claude/Gemini/SWE wires that were deliberately left byte-identical, changing three families to test one

the too-short-prompt floor is dropped — a cache WRITE is requested for a trivial prompt, and a write costs roughly an order of magnitude more than a read, so the 'optimisation' bills more than it saves
the cache mode is emitted as 0 instead of EPHEMERAL(1) — protobuf omits zero-valued scalars, so #13 arrives as an empty sub-message and the request silently asks for nothing while looking enabled

the #13 spread emits the mode varint at the TOP level instead of wrapping it in the sub-message — field 1 of the request (ClientMetadata) collides with a bare varint, corrupting the metadata the upstream authenticates on
